name: Logic Puzzle - Knights and Knaves
problem: On an island, knights always tell the truth and knaves always lie. You meet three inhabitants: A, B, and C. A says: 'Exactly one of us is a knight.' B says: 'Exactly two of us are knights.' C says: 'All three of us are knights.' How many knights are there?
notes: Classic logic puzzle. Multiple trajectories can test each possible configuration (0, 1, 2, 3 knights) independently and verify consistency.
